data.one_liner: Mediation adapter for ironSource ad network using the google_mobile_ads plugin.
data.what_it_does: This plugin enables sending ad requests to the ironSource ad network through the Google Mobile Ads SDK for Flutter applications on Android and iOS. It acts as a mediation adapter, allowing monetization via ironSource alongside AdMob.
use_when: You are using the google_mobile_ads plugin and want to include ironSource as a mediation source.
You need to display ironSource ads in a Flutter app targeting Android or iOS.
avoid_when: You are not using the Google Mobile Ads plugin.
You do not use ironSource for ad monetization.
strengths: Official Google Mobile Ads mediation adapter for ironSource.
Supports Swift Package Manager on iOS and handles platform bridging via Pigeon.
weaknesses: Requires maintaining and configuring multiple native SDK dependencies via Google Mobile Ads.
data.setup_notes: Requires following the Google Mobile Ads developer guide for ironSource and configuring the native ironSource SDK for Android and iOS.

alternatives.name: google_mobile_ads
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need standard Google Mobile Ads without ironSource mediation.

alternatives.name: applovin_max
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to use AppLovin MAX mediation instead of ironSource.
